test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When did the Ministry of Human Resource Development launch Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan which the scheme focuses on improving the quality of education and using technology to empower children and teachers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**May 2018**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Samagra Shiksha:**

 
 
• **Ministry of Human Resource Development **is implementing the **Scheme of Vocationalisation of School Education.**
 
• Samagra Shiksha is an overarching programme for the school education sector extending from pre-school to class 12.
 
• The scheme has been prepared with the broader goal of improving school effectiveness measured in terms of equal opportunities for schooling and equitable learning outcomes.
 
• **It subsumes the three Schemes of Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA), Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA), and Teacher Education (TE).**
 
• **It was launched in May 2018. Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• The above scheme is being implemented under the umbrella of **‘Samagra Shiksha – an integrated scheme for school education.**
 
• Samagra Shiksha is an** integrated** scheme for school education extending from **pre-school to class XII** to ensure inclusive and equitable quality education at **all levels** of school education.
 
• It **subsumes** the three Schemes of** Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA), Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA), and Teacher Education (TE).**
 
• The change in name of the **Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD) as Ministry of Education. **
 
• **The current Education Minister of India is Shri Dharmendra Pradhan** (As of Jan 2022).
